issue.title: Resolve fmt-md-check failure on SASE memory Markdown
issue.description: Reproduction on 2026-08-09: running just check in the sase repo fails at the fmt markdown gate. The failing command is node_modules/.bin/prettier --check **/*.md, which reports [warn] sase/memory/build_and_run.md and exits nonzero before lint or tests run. The file is a canonical SASE memory note, and repo instructions forbid agents from editing sase/memory/*.md without explicit user approval. Scope: either apply the approved memory formatting workflow by editing the canonical memory note and running sase memory init, or adjust the Markdown formatting gate so canonical/generated memory files do not block ordinary repo checks when agents cannot edit them.

payload.entry: NO LONGER REPRODUCES at master ee9603d31: `just fmt-md-check` (prettier --check '**/*.md') passes clean, so the build_and_run.md line-wrap drift this bead tracks is gone — commit 0c2d5dd71 'chore: format build_and_run.md' reformatted the file. Verified by sase-ib.land while landing epic sase-ib (phase sase-ib.3 filed this bead, and phase sase-ib.7 recorded the same drift as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP). If the generator itself still emits non-prettier output, that residual concern is worth keeping; the blocking symptom is not.
